title: The giant theater room.
content: This is the best I could get canva to do. In my mall world dreams, I very commonly visit this gargantuan, nonsensical theater. It has more screens than this, and each screen has its own section for seating. Sometimes people are just lounging on blankets and pillows. The screens are at way different angles, and there are more stairs and levels to navigate. Different shows are playing on the screens at the same time commonly. Anyone else seen this place?
